sources.snippet: Hi! My name is Sung-hwan Han. I am an M.S. student in the High Performance AI System Lab at Sogang University, advised by Prof. Youngmin Yi. My research focuses on two areas: Efficient inference and deployment of AI models, particularly Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models Human-Robot Interaction (HRI), with an emphasis on Robots for Good Across both areas, I am driven by a single goal ...

sources.title: NVIDIA/Isaac-GR00T: NVIDIA Isaac GR00T N1.7 - GitHub
sources.snippet: Previous releases: N1.6 | N1.5 NVIDIA Isaac GR00T N1.7 is an open vision-language-action (VLA) model for generalized humanoid robot skills. This cross-embodiment model takes multimodal input, including language and images, to perform manipulation tasks in diverse environments.
